description: This file defines the ICatalogItemService interface, which declares asynchronous methods for creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving catalog items in the eShopOnWeb application's BlazorShared project.

classes.name: ICatalogItemService
classes.description: Interface for catalog item operations including create, edit, delete, get by id, and list methods.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Edit
methods.description: Edits an existing catalog item asynchronously.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes a catalog item by id asynchronously.

methods.name: GetById
methods.description: Retrieves a catalog item by id asynchronously.

methods.name: ListPaged
methods.description: Returns a list of catalog items with pagination asynchronously.

methods.name: List
methods.description: Returns a list of all catalog items asynchronously.
